## Background

I'm a strategic management student at BYU Marriott, graduating April 2027, and I currently lead product and AI at Leland—where I design and run the AI Builder Program (AIBP), a cohort-based course teaching professionals to build production-ready AI workflows. I also independently build and ship Bankaroo, a live fintech app helping families manage kids' finances.

I'm drawn to product work at the intersection of user empathy, AI, and design. I approach problems by starting with real user needs, then translating those insights into systems and experiences that create lasting value. I bring hands-on experience across the PM toolkit: user research, roadmap prioritization, iterative shipping, and cross-functional collaboration—earned through building products with real users.
